2607.11116.title: The Equilibrium Is the Initialization: Lazy Identity Collapse in Physics-Structured Deep Equilibrium Reasoning
2607.11116.paper_summary: Deep equilibrium models promise input-adaptive implicit computation: harder problems should demand more solver iterations, and the solved equilibrium should encode the result of genuine iterative inference. We report a cautionary study of a port-Hamiltonian DEQ with a learned initialization on two reasoning tasks -- ProofWriter entailment over frozen DeBERTa embeddings and a BFS-verified graph-reachability benchmark -- in which the implicit computation is a silent no-op. Across tasks, seeds, and controlled ablation arms, the solved equilibrium equals the solver's start point to numerical precision, and bypassing the solver entirely changes test accuracy by +0.00 percentage points in 18 of 19 training runs. Controlled interventions falsify the tempting explanation: removing the anchoring term reproduces every result, and retraining with noise-decoupled starts yields a solver that converges to the noisy start while the decoder learns to ignore it. The single escaping run diverges instead ($\|h^{*}-z_0\|=171$), producing a co-adapted noise channel whose removal improves accuracy. Iteration counts are uncorrelated with ground-truth difficulty ($r=0.009$), and the full apparatus never outperforms a two-layer MLP on either task. We trace the mechanism to gradient starvation along two distinct routes, show that the standard zeroing ablation is confounded and gives wildly seed-dependent answers where the correct substitution test gives a stable zero, and distill a four-test diagnostic protocol for auditing claimed implicit computation. All experiments run on a single free Colab GPU; code, raw logs, and analysis scripts are released.
2607.11116.paper_summary_zh: 深度平衡模型承諾輸入自適應的隱式計算：更難的問題應該需要更多的求解器迭代，而解決的平衡應該編碼真實迭代推理的結果。我們報告了一項警示性研究，針對一個具有學習初始化的端-哈密頓 DEQ，進行了兩個推理任務的實驗——在凍結的 DeBERTa 嵌入上進行的 ProofWriter 蕴涵和一個經 BFS 驗證的圖可達性基準——在這些任務中，隱式計算是一個靜默的無操作。在各個任務、隨機種子和控制消融實驗中，解決的平衡在數值精度上等於求解器的起始點，完全繞過求解器則在 19 次訓練運行中的 18 次改變了測試準確度，變化幅度為 +0.00 個百分點。控制性干預否定了這一誘人的解釋：去除錨定項重現了每一個結果，而用去噪聲解耦的起始點重新訓練則產生了一個收斂於嘈雜起始點的求解器，而解碼器學會忽略它。唯一的逃逸運行則相反地發散（$\|h^{*}-z_0\|=171$），產生了一個共同適應的噪聲通道，其去除改善了準確度。迭代次數與真實難度無關（$r=0.009$），而整個裝置在任何任務上都未能超越兩層 MLP。我們追溯機制至沿著兩條不同路徑的梯度饑餓，顯示標準的零化消融被混淆，並給出極其依賴隨機種子的答案，而正確的替代測試則給出穩定的零，並提煉出一個四測試診斷協議以審核所聲稱的隱式計算。所有實驗均在單個免費的 Colab GPU 上運行；代碼、原始日誌和分析腳本已發布。
2607.11116.author: Joyjeet Singh et.al.
